# Revealjs and Peer Feedback {.unnumbered}

## Goal

Students turn one dashboard finding into a short scientific communication product and practice structured peer feedback.

## Minimal Revealjs Starter

```yaml
---
title: "NHANES Equity Dashboard Finding"
format: revealjs
---
```

## Three-Slide Structure

1. **Question and audience:** Who needs this finding, and why?
2. **Evidence:** Show one dashboard plot or table and state the descriptive pattern.
3. **Limitation and action:** Name what the data can and cannot support, then state the next decision or question.

## Peer Feedback Form

| Prompt | Peer note |
|---|---|
| What is the main message? |  |
| What evidence supports it? |  |
| What is unclear or overclaimed? |  |
| Is the limitation visible? |  |
| What would improve audience fit? |  |

## Student Output

Submit a rendered slide deck or slide outline with the completed peer feedback form. Include a source note for CDC NHANES and an AI-use note if AI helped draft the wording.
